related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.work_intent_alignment_status: the persisted WorkIntent predates the current environmental capability campaign objective
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Preserve operational evidence, relate objective, subsystem, implementation, verification, and subsequent consequences, and represent uncertainty accurately.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environmental Capability multi-page evidence projection

outcome.implementation_change: The bounded page reader still selects observations independently per page, then orders the selected references by absolute campaign evidence offset before processing them. Append-only corrections can therefore validate that their exact targets precede them even when the target and correction were read from different pages.
outcome.verified_change: The cross-page regression passed. The live projection recovered both exact correction targets, preserved their original identities, paths, and SHA-256 values, reported 6 of 6 selected records verified and 0 unavailable, applied 2 corrections with 0 unverified, and verified all 10 selected source pointers. The registry-linked provider-effect relation became present in the same projection with its verification record integrity checked.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The projection response remained partial because its 74,505-byte pre-compaction representation exceeded the configured result budget. The selected correction and improvement relationships were returned, but the full unabridged campaign history was not.
